49090-love-in-a-muddle.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. I walked for a long time. It was a topping night, the air was as soft and warm as cotton-wool and the moon was on the sea. It was the sort of night that makes you want to do a frightful lot of good in the world, mother a lot of orphans or marry a man from St. I could have cried because there was such a lot of sorrow and unhappiness in the world. You do feel like that sometimes out of doors.

arxiv-2107-11069.title: 𝒩 = ( 2 , 2 ) \mathcal{N}=(2,2) extended 𝔰 ​ 𝔩 ​ ( 3 | 2 ) \mathfrak{sl}(3|2) Chern - Simons A ​ d ​ S 3 AdS_{3} supergravity with new boundaries
arxiv-2107-11069.creator: H. T. Özer, Aytül Filiz
arxiv-2107-11069.description: Abstract We present the first example of 𝒩 = ( 2 , 2 ) \mathcal{N}=(2,2) formulation for the extended higher-spin A ​ d ​ S 3 AdS_{3} supergravity with the most general boundary conditions as an extension of the 𝒩 = ( 1 , 1 ) \mathcal{N}=(1,1) work, discovered recently by us Ozer:2019nkv .

arxiv-2204-05455.title: Quantum entangled states of a classically radiating macroscopic spin
arxiv-2204-05455.creator: Ori Somech, Ephraim Shahmoon
arxiv-2204-05455.description: Abstract Entanglement constitutes a main feature that distinguishes quantum from classical physics and is a key resource of quantum technologies. Here we show, however, that entanglement may also serve as the essential ingredient for the emergence of classical behavior in a composite nonlinear radiating system.

arxiv-2207-07087.title: Parameter-Efficient Prompt Tuning Makes Generalized and Calibrated Neural Text Retrievers
arxiv-2207-07087.creator: Weng Lam Tam, Xiao Liu, Kaixuan Ji, Lilong Xue, Xingjian Zhang, Yuxiao Dong, Jiahua Liu, Maodi Hu, Jie Tang
arxiv-2207-07087.description: Abstract Prompt tuning attempts to update few task-specific parameters in pre-trained models. It has achieved comparable performance to fine-tuning of the full parameter set on both language understanding and generation tasks. In this work, we study the problem of prompt tuning for neural text retrievers. We introduce parameter-efficient prompt tuning for text retrieval across in-domain, cross-domain, and cross-topic settings.

arxiv-2405-09931.title: Learning from Observer Gaze: Zero-Shot Attention Prediction Oriented by Human-Object Interaction Recognition
arxiv-2405-09931.creator: Yuchen Zhou, Linkai Liu, Chao Gou
arxiv-2405-09931.description: Abstract Most existing attention prediction research focuses on salient instances like humans and objects. However, the more complex interaction-oriented attention, arising from the comprehension of interactions between instances by human observers, remains largely unexplored. This is equally crucial for advancing human-machine interaction and human-centered artificial intelligence.

arxiv-2406-01837.title: Boosting Vision-Language Models with Transduction
arxiv-2406-01837.creator: Maxime Zanella, Benoît Gérin *, Ismail Ben Ayed, Code : https://github.com/MaxZanella/transduction-for-vlms
arxiv-2406-01837.description: Abstract Transduction is a powerful paradigm that leverages the structure of unlabeled data to boost predictive accuracy. We present TransCLIP, a novel and computationally efficient transductive approach designed for Vision-Language Models (VLMs). TransCLIP is applicable as a plug-and-play module on top of popular inductive zero- and few-shot models, consistently improving their performances.

arxiv-2410-14791.title: Axion effects on gamma-ray spectral irregularities. II: Implications of EBL absorption
arxiv-2410-14791.creator: Hai-Jun Li, Wei Chao, Xiu-Hui Tan, Yu-Feng Zhou
arxiv-2410-14791.description: Abstract The extragalactic background light (EBL) plays a crucial role in the propagation of high-energy particles throughout the Universe. In this work, we explore the impact of the EBL absorption effect on photon to axionlike particle (ALP) conversions from the very-high-energy gamma-ray spectral irregularities.

arxiv-2501-03095.title: A Novel Structure-Agnostic Multi-Objective Approach for Weight-Sharing Compression in Deep Neural Networks
arxiv-2501-03095.creator: Rasa Khosrowshahli, Student Member, IEEE, Shahryar Rahnamayan, Senior Member, IEEE, Beatrice Ombuki-Berman, Senior Member, IEEE
arxiv-2501-03095.description: Abstract Deep neural networks suffer from storing millions and billions of weights in memory post-training, making challenging memory-intensive models to deploy on embedded devices. The weight-sharing technique is one of the popular compression approaches that use fewer weight values and share across specific connections in the network.

arxiv-2606-24874.title: FLUX3D: High-Fidelity 3D Gaussian Generation with Diffusion-Aligned Sparse Representation
arxiv-2606-24874.creator: Haorui Ji, Weizhe Liu, Hongdong Li, Hengkai Guo

pmc-10533169.title: The Influence of Poultry Manure-Derived Biochar and Compost on Soil Properties and Plant Biomass Growth
pmc-10533169.creator: Danuta Dróżdż, Krystyna Malińska, Katarzyna Wystalska, Erik Meers, Ana Robles-Aguilar
pmc-10533169.description: Promising methods for managing poultry manure (PM) include converting poultry manure through pyrolysis to biochar, which can be used for soil applications. The overall goal of this study was to determine the effects of poultry manure-derived biochar and compost on the soil and growth of cherry tomatoes.

pmc-10632417.title: A review of supply chain quality management practices in sustainable food networks
pmc-10632417.creator: Patrick Robert Burgess, Funlade T Sunmola, Sigrid Wertheim-Heck
pmc-10632417.description: Supply chain quality management practices are necessary to improve processes, meet consumer quality needs, and enhance supply chain quality management performance in sustainable food networks. Food supply chain quality management and associated practices are considerably studied in global food systems, less so for alternative food networks.

pmc-11358055.title: Abdominal endovascular aneurysm repair using an aorto-uni-iliac device resulting in resting lower extremity pain: a case report and discussion on patient selection
pmc-11358055.creator: John R Ekblad, Colleen Hupp
pmc-11358055.description: Abdominal aortic aneurysms that meet criteria for repair are often managed with endovascular aneurysm repair using a bifurcated two-piece or bifurcated single-body stent. Patients with difficult anatomy, extensive calcifications, complete occlusion of common or external iliac artery, tortuous vessels, or small vessels may require placement of an Aorto-Uni-Iliac (AUI) stent graft.

pmc-11475569.title: Tumor-Associated Macrophages as Major Immunosuppressive Cells in the Tumor Microenvironment
pmc-11475569.creator: Anghesom Ghebremedhin, Dipti Athavale, Yanting Zhang, Xiaodan Yao, Curt Balch, Shumei Song, Akiteru Goto
pmc-11475569.description: Simple SummaryThe tumor microenvironment (TME) refers to the area immediately surrounding a cancerous tumor that influences the tumor’s behavior and how the immune system reacts to it. Central to the TME environment are special immune cells—tumor-associated macrophages (TAMs)—that, rather than restrict the tumor, actually facilitate tumor growth and metastasis. Thus, targeting these TAMs can help to eliminate cancer.

pmc-11490209.title: Exenatide-Modified Deferoxamine-Based Nanoparticles Ameliorates Neurological Deficits in Parkinson’s Disease Mice
pmc-11490209.creator: Yiming Huang, Xinran Wang, Wenjing Li, Feng Yue, Miao Wang, Feifan Zhou
pmc-11490209.description: PurposeTo avoid the biotoxicity and poor bioavailability of deferoxamine mesylate (DFO), an iron chelation for the treatment of Parkinson’s disease (PD), a self-oriented DFO nanoparticle functionalized with Exendin-4 was developed, which can be targeted delivered into the lesion brain area to achieve synergistic effects against PD by iron chelation and inflammatory suppression.

pmc-11543912.title: From prescription to pollution: The ecological consequences of NSAIDs in aquatic ecosystems
pmc-11543912.creator: Divya Lakshmi S, Vijaya Geetha B, Vibha Murali
pmc-11543912.description: Nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs are widely utilised to alleviate pain and reduce inflammation in both human and veterinary medicine. Despite their therapeutic benefits, NSAIDs pose environmental concerns due to their possible ecotoxicity. NSAIDs can enter aquatic ecosystems through wastewater discharge as it is very difficult to extract NSAIDs by conventional wastewater treatment, thus affecting aquatic life.

pmc-11611419.title: Successful Use of the Er,Cr:YSGG Laser for Gingival Depigmentation
pmc-11611419.creator: Rana Almusallam, Maha Ali Al-Mohaya
pmc-11611419.description: The color of the gingiva is determined by the degree of vascularization, epithelial thickness, and the number of melanin pigments within the epithelium. Melanin pigmentation is caused by abnormal or increased deposition of melanin by active melanocytes located mainly in the basal and supra-basal cell layers of the oral epithelium.

pmc-11635163.title: Prediction Model and Decision Analysis for Early Recognition of SDNS/FRNS in Children
pmc-11635163.creator: Hui Yin, Xiao Lin, Chun Gan, Han Xiao, Yaru Jiang, Xindi Zhou, Qing Yang, Wei Jiang, Mo Wang, Haiping Yang, Gaofu Zhang, Han Chan, Qiu Li
pmc-11635163.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). PurposeThis study identified factors that identification of progression-predicting utility from steroid-sensitive nephrotic syndrome(SSNS) to steroid-dependent or frequently relapsing nephrotic syndrome (SDNS/FRNS) in patients and developed a corresponding predictive model.Patients and MethodsThis retrospective study analyzed clinical data from 756 patients aged 1 to 18 years, diagnosed with SSNS, who received treatment at the Department of Nephrology, Children’s Hospital of Chongqing Medical University, between November 2007 and May 2023.

pmc-11642697.title: Combined Therapy with Azathioprine, Prednisone, and Enalapril in Children with IgAN and IgAVN
pmc-11642697.creator: Małgorzata Mizerska-Wasiak, Miłosz Starczyński, Wojciech Wasiak, Jadwiga Małdyk, Emilia Płatos, Małgorzata Pańczyk-Tomaszewska, Hiroshi Tanaka
pmc-11642697.description: Background: The aim of this study was to evaluate the efficacy of 1-year treatment in children with IgAN and IgAVN using azathioprine, prednisone, and enalapril (AZA+PRED+E) combined with a control kidney biopsy. Methods: This study consists of 68 children diagnosed via kidney biopsy with Oxford classification.

pmc-12437906.title: Socioeconomic inequalities on unmet needs for mental health care: a cross-section analysis in European Union countries
pmc-12437906.creator: J V Santos, V Pinheiro
pmc-12437906.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). IntroductionMental health disorders are a leading cause of disability in European Union countries. Previous evidence highlighted the role of socioeconomic inequalities on unmet mental health care needs, varying by income or education.

pmc-12470594.title: The Role of Age at Onset on the Clinical Course and Biochemical Parameters of Anorexia Nervosa
pmc-12470594.creator: Lorenzo Ferrario, Andrea Costantino, Letizia Maria Affaticati, Massimo Clerici, Antonios Dakanalis, Enrico Capuzzi, Massimiliano Buoli, Octavian Vasiliu, Rajendra D Badgaiyan
pmc-12470594.description: Background: Anorexia nervosa (AN) has the highest mortality rate among psychiatric disorders, making early diagnosis and tailored management crucial. This study aimed to evaluate the impact of age at onset (AAO)—childhood/adolescence versus adulthood—on the clinical course and associated biochemical parameters. Methods: Seventy-six female patients with AN were divided into two groups based on AAO (<18 years vs. ≥18 years).

pmc-12658969.title: CAFFEINE CONSUMPTION AS A POTENTIAL RISK FACTOR OF OSTEOPOROSIS DEVELOPMENT AMONG NIGHT SHIFT WORKERS: EPIDEMIOLOGICAL EVIDENCES AND HYPOTHESIS
pmc-12658969.creator: Agnieszka Bukowska-Damska, Joanna Jurewicz, Ewa Jabłońska
pmc-12658969.description: Night workers have demonstrated an increased risk of bone fracture. The mechanisms underlying the observed bone changes among night workers remain unclear. They have been attributed to hormonal changes resulting from exposure to light during nighttime, sleep restrictions and disturbances in expression of circadian rhythms genes.

pmc-12689523.title: Stem cell activity shapes the pleiotropic effects of IFN-γ and TGF-β in autoimmune diseases, infections, and cancer, and drives autoimmune flares and remissions
pmc-12689523.creator: Zeev Elkoshi
pmc-12689523.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). This work introduces stem cell activity as a central factor contributing to the pleiotropic effects of IFN-γ and TGF-β1, as well as to the fluctuations of autoimmune diseases (AIDs) between flares and remissions. Analysis of published data on hair follicle immune privilege indicates that immune protection is not an inherent feature of quiescent stem cells, as previously proposed, but instead depends on the specific pathways that regulate quiescence.

pmc-12720161.title: Survey on therapeutic drug monitoring practices for nontuberculous mycobacterial infections: an NTMnet/ESGMYC collaborative study
pmc-12720161.creator: Victor Næstholt Dahl, Nicole Maranchick, Jakko van Ingen, Rob Aarnoutse
pmc-12720161.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). ExtractThe treatment of nontuberculous mycobacterial (NTM) disease is lengthy and requires multiple drugs, often associated with adverse effects [1]. Treatment failure and recurrence are also common [2]. Drug over- and underexposure may contribute to toxicity and treatment failure [3–5]. Still, information on the use of therapeutic drug monitoring (TDM) – the individualisation of drug dosing based on drug concentration measurements – to optimise NTM disease management is very limited.

pmc-13053174.title: Cerebral Sympathetic Nervous System Activation Promotes Intrarenal Renin-Angiotensin System Activity and Salt-Induced Nocturnal Polyuria
pmc-13053174.creator: Go Tsujimura, Kentaro Takezawa, Teppei Wakita, Yuma Kujime, Hiroaki Kitakaze, Norichika Ueda, Shinichiro Fukuhara, Shuhei Kobuchi, Yoshihide Fujisawa, Akira Nishiyama, Hiromitsu Negoro, Yoshihisa Koyama, Shoichi Shimada, Norio Nonomura
pmc-13053174.description: PurposeThis study was aimed at assessing the effects of cerebral sympathetic nervous system activity and renal denervation (RD) on the intrarenal renin-angiotensin system (RAS) and salt-induced nocturnal polyuria (NP).MethodsTo establish a mouse model, NP was induced by Nω-nitro-L-arginine methyl ester and a high-salt diet.

pmc-13159016.title: Photo- and thermo-responsive complementary metal coordination for the construction of supramolecular polymers
pmc-13159016.creator: Shenghui Rao, Yuzhen Wang, Ju-An Zhang, Liqing Li, Shaoyu Li, Linlin Liu, Yu Xie, Hui Li, Wei Tian
pmc-13159016.description: Among diverse metal coordination interactions, complementary metal–ligand coordination stands out as a significant category, featuring captivating coordination geometries and excellent binding capacity. Although some complementary ligand pairs have been developed, few studies have focused on the regulation of their coordination structures or the exploration of synergistic effects between different coordination motifs.

pmc-13389855.title: Synergistic bimetallic Fe–Cu@hydrochar composite for efficient pharmaceutical removal via coupled adsorption and Fenton-like catalysis
pmc-13389855.creator: Maria Aslam, Zia Ul Haq Khan, Mahmood M. S. Abdullah, Amjad Khan, Fida Ullah, Muhammad Idrees
pmc-13389855.description: Azithromycin (AZM), a commonly prescribed macrolide antibiotic, is an environmental contaminant that necessitates efficient removal methods. In this research, the synthesis of a novel Fe–Cu/hydrochar nanocomposite (Fe–Cu/HC) and its utilization for the removal of AZM through adsorption and a modified Fenton reaction have been investigated.

uslaw-usc-t14-s715.title: 14 U.S.C. § 715 — Oceanographic research
uslaw-usc-t14-s715.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t14-s715.description: United States Code, Title 14 (Coast Guard); Chapter 7 (Cooperation). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Coast Guard shall conduct such oceanographic research, use such equipment or instruments, and collect and analyze such oceanographic data, in cooperation with other agencies of the Government, or not, as may be in the national interest.
